Backpressure cannot create capacity; retries can amplify overload, local decisions can be inconsistent, and distributed control does not eliminate the need for static bounds or centralized rate limiting.
claims.statement: [[ServiceHealthChecks]] should match the control decision: coarse liveness can support restart, while [[NetworkLoadBalancing]] needs latency, queue, concurrency, correctness, and real-work capacity signals. [[AdaptiveBackpressure]] then propagates worker refusal through rerouting, bounded queueing, rejection, and retry backoff so a reachable but overloaded service does not spread failure.

qualifications: The evidence is one 2016 practitioner comparison without marketplace adoption, price, retention, service-quality, or automation outcome data.
The comparison simplifies both categories and does not test specialized projects, managed marketplaces, credential-based governance, hybrid delivery, regulatory variation, or later AI capabilities.
claims.statement: [[ServiceMarketplaceFit]] depends on work structure rather than interface analogy: [[Uber]]'s short, frequent, bounded transactions differ from diagnostic, long-lived accounting relationships, while [[HumanPremiumServices]] explains why judgment, confidentiality, and accumulated client context may remain valuable even as standardized tasks are automated.

qualifications: The example is one self-reported 2014 implementation, not comparative evidence that spreadsheet composition improves relationship, learning, or operational outcomes.
The user still owns category design, manual entry, record freshness, sensitive-data protection, query limits, and any migration when spreadsheet scale or collaboration needs become binding.
claims.statement: [[EndUserComputing]] can emerge from composing familiar data primitives rather than writing conventional code: [[KheHy]] combines a controlled vocabulary, validation-backed typeahead, contact rows, notes, and filter views into a [[PersonalCRM]] for relationship retrieval.

qualifications: The source is a short 2016 practitioner explanation, not evidence that one style improves learning, review, or defect outcomes across teams.
The dictionary example does not cover concurrent state changes, irreversible actions, user-facing validation, or workload-specific exception costs.
The communication benefit depends on catching only the anticipated failure and keeping unrelated work outside the `try` block.
claims.statement: Programming practice uses code structure to communicate expected and alternative paths: [[EAFPAndLBYL]] contrasts attempting a normal operation with checking its precondition first, while [[BrettCannon]] connects readable [[Python]] exception handling to narrow `try` scope, specific exceptions, [[FunctionDesign]], and [[InternalSoftwareQuality]].

qualifications: The evidence is one 2013 founder-practitioner proposal using selected Moz examples rather than measured implementation, retention, compensation-equity, promotion, or team-performance outcomes.

Senior contributors often mentor and shape strategy, managers may need hands-on expertise, and role fit can change; the tracks should not become fixed personality labels or conceal unequal authority behind equivalent titles.
claims.statement: [[DualCareerTracks]] separate seniority from direct-report count: individual contributors can gain wider strategic scope and equivalent compensation while [[ManagementRoleFit]] reserves people management for those able and motivated to enable others through mentoring, staffing, feedback, team health, and organizational context. This extends [[EngineeringCareerArchitecture]], [[ProductDesignCareerLadder]], and [[EngineeringTeamMotivation]] without making the two roles identical.

summary: [[PublicSoftware]] adds a qualified distinction between license-backed open-source rights and the broader culture of public creation: user freedoms remain essential, while stewardship also needs explicit roles, time, compensation, and governance. The proposal is historical and unvalidated terminology, so visibility must not be mistaken for permission. [[EndUserComputing]] gains a data-oriented personal-CRM case in which a non-specialist composes validation, typeahead, controlled tags, notes, and filter views into a useful application; its accessibility does not remove governance, privacy, maintenance, or scale constraints. [[StartupJobDiligence]] now extends beyond pre-offer assessment into continued verification of funding, payroll, contractual payments, founder conduct, and documentary evidence after joining; the added [[StartupGrind]] account is anonymized, retrospective, historically bounded, and visually incomplete rather than predictive. [[DurableNoteWriting]] adds a future-reader constraint to knowledge systems: [[SaschaFast]] places interpretation and retrieval cost inside the prose and structure of each long-lived note, while [[ChristianTietze]] supplies a repair loop for unclear legacy material. The source is practitioner guidance rather than comparative evidence, and its lifetime standard should not be imposed on every transient note. [[ParticipatoryProductDesign]] adds a power-aware collaboration case: intended users can shape products before implementation, but representation, consent, compensation, privacy, and safeguarding determine whether participation is legitimate. [[ServiceMarketplaceFit]] adds a professional-work boundary: short, bounded, easily specified transactions are more compatible with on-demand matching than diagnostic, long-lived work whose technical quality clients struggle to evaluate, while [[HumanPremiumServices]] explains why judgment and accumulated context may remain part of the service. [[AsynchronousWorkplaceCommunication]] adds a qualified workplace-design pattern in which durable writing, contextual placement, delayed response, and predictable check-ins can reduce schedule synchronization without making meetings universally unnecessary. [[WorkLifeBalance]] now combines life-phase sequencing with concurrent weekly allocation: [[EvWilliams]] adds varied schedules, work location, and childcare support while his non-representative founder-heavy survey cannot define a healthy universal norm. [[TechnicalLeadershipRoleDesign]] adds a source-scoped workplace boundary: senior technical work need not move monotonically from coding to management, because explicit responsibility can return to implementation when engineering limits discovery, while intense focus practices and founder narratives require wellbeing, accountability, and evidence qualifications. [[GraphQL]] and [[RESTAPI]] add a source-scoped collaboration boundary: PayPal reports that schema discovery and client-selected fields reduced internal API-search and fixed-response coordination during a six-week mobile project, but the company account supplies no controlled productivity or performance comparison and the model redistributes rather than removes contract, implementation, and operational work. [[EngineeringExpertise]] adds a cross-layer practice model to work and learning: [[PaulBuchheit]] connects sustained construction and diagnosis with movement across hardware, kernels, protocols, systems, applications, and product consequences, while his exceptional early-Google retrospective leaves transfer, support, and burnout limits explicit. [[HumanResourcesGovernance]] adds scale-aware HR leadership, feedback, rules, and onboarding to the workplace synthesis, while [[WhistleblowerReportingSystems]] adds training and redundant reporting channels; both remain source-scoped without employee outcomes, independence, anti-retaliation, or investigation evidence. Work, education, and social systems are practice-rich environments in which accessible entry points, active learning, feedback, judgment, role clarity, fair incentives, consent, opportunity structure, and boundaries around attention and power shape outcomes. The corpus spans careers, management, collaboration, technical delivery, workplace policy, creative and independent work, knowledge systems, privacy, media, relationships, and automation, with recurring qualifications around access, evidence, transfer, and structural constraint. [[ProgrammerInterruptionRecovery]] adds that demanding technical work can lose task state as well as clock time, making protected focus and explicit resumption cues complementary while leaving reported delays and physiological signals source-scoped. [[OnlineDatingSocialIntegration]] adds a model in which digitally created absent ties can weaken network-level [[Homophily]], while the observed meeting-channel shift does not establish causal effects on interracial marriage or stability. Personal benchmarks can preserve distinctive work and reveal progress, while [[StartupJobDiligence]] adds observed [[StartupCulture]], learning return, and recruiting evidence as bounded career-choice inputs rather than substitutes for business, compensation, and personal-fit evidence. Creator work shows a labor-design boundary: platforms can reduce monetization and discovery friction, but fragmented creator networks make audience access insufficient without durable economics, tools, community support, and reasons to stay. [[ContextCollapse]] shows that attention can remain high while heterogeneous audiences suppress personal participation. Pinterest's onboarding case makes first-mile requests conditional on clear timing, value, consent, and privacy. The graduate-finance source adds a narrow 2016 case in which saving and liquidity can widen career choice but current individualized verification remains necessary. New [[ProductManagerHiring]] adds reciprocal, stage-sensitive role evaluation and honest candidate closing, while underscoring that unvalidated pedigree, culture, enthusiasm, and presentation signals require accessibility and adverse-impact controls. [[CrossCulturalWorkplaceAdaptation]] adds a source-scoped distinction between understanding local technical and social constraints and using culture to excuse avoidable operational or human harm. [[GameIndustryLaborPrecarity]] adds that passion and creative ownership do not absorb project, schedule, relocation, compensation, governance, or discrimination risk; studio exit and indie work can shift those risks rather than eliminate them. [[ReversibleDecisionMaking]] adds an organizational-learning boundary: teams can reduce heavyweight review for genuinely correctable choices, but decentralization is safe only when rollback cost, affected people, persistent data, trust, and safety are included in the classification. [[StaffMeetings]] adds a conditional workplace coordination mechanism: purpose, participant ownership, shared records, and follow-up must remain visible and repeatedly reassessed, with [[ProceduralRationality]] and [[PsychologicalSafety]] limiting what the formal design alone can establish. [[ServiceHealthChecks]] and [[AdaptiveBackpressure]] add a distributed-work boundary: service capacity should be measured against real work, and bounded refusal, rerouting, queueing, rejection, and retry backoff should keep local overload from spreading, while the historical [[Spillway]] case remains qualitative and implementation-specific. The 9-to-5 developer account adds daily stopping rules to [[WorkLifeBalance]], separates engineering competence from routine overtime and extracurricular visibility, and links impossible knowledge standards plus upward comparison to [[ImposterSyndrome]] and burnout pressure; its personal evidence does not establish one universal or equally enforceable schedule. [[LuckAndEffortInSuccess]] and [[DeliberateNetworkBuilding]] now make social infrastructure explicit: [[ArnoldSchwarzenegger]] pairs agency with parents, teachers, coaches, shelter, role models, sponsorship, career access, voters, and continued learning, while the autobiographical evidence cannot establish causal weights or equal access to help. [[CandidateRejectionFeedback]] adds a post-selection boundary to [[HiringSystemDesign]]: individualized rejection detail helps only when structured evidence, bounded language, decision clarity, editorial review, and iteration outweigh workload and the risk of reinforcing perceived misunderstanding; the [[KelseyPiper]] and [[Triplebyte]] account is self-reported and does not establish universal candidate benefit or legal safety. [[EAFPAndLBYL]] adds a source-scoped programming-practice lesson: control-flow structure teaches and communicates assumptions only when exception scope remains precise, and the article does not establish one universally clearer style.
